AboutUs.title: About Me
AboutUs.quote: Representation and defense of commercial interests in judicial disputes and arbitrations with the highest technical rigor.
AboutUs.body: With more than two decades of experience in the legal sector, I have specialized in designing complex strategies to protect the assets and reputation of national and international corporations. My approach combines academic sophistication with a pragmatic business vision, ensuring robust solutions both in commercial litigation and in highly complex arbitration tribunals.
AboutUs.credentialOne: Active member of the Spanish Bar Association
AboutUs.credentialTwo: Certified specialist in Commercial Law and Mergers
AboutUs.credentialThree: Certified arbitrator by the Commercial Arbitration Center
AboutUs.imageAlt: Attorney specialized in commercial law and arbitration

PracticeAreas.corporateText: Company formation, corporate governance, and legal structuring of business projects.

FAQ.title: I answer your questions before we get started
FAQ.description: Didn't find the answer you were looking for? Write to me for personalized advice.
FAQ.questionOne: How do I schedule a first consultation?
FAQ.answerOne: You can schedule your consultation directly through the 'Schedule Consultation' button on our website, selecting the date and time that best suits your availability, or by sending me a direct message via WhatsApp.
FAQ.answerTwo: Our main office is located in a central corporate area. We serve clients in person by appointment and also offer services at executive locations upon request.
FAQ.questionThree: What areas of law do you practice?
FAQ.answerThree: We specialize in Corporate, Commercial, Civil, Labor, Intellectual Property, and Commercial Litigation and Arbitration law.
FAQ.answerFour: Yes, we offer 100% virtual consultation sessions via video call for national and international clients with the same effectiveness and technical rigor as an in-person consultation.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: Information on the processing of personal data collected through this website, in accordance with the applicable data protection and privacy regulations in the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionOneBodyOne: Through the contact forms, email links, telephone, and other means of communication available on this website, we may collect personal data that you voluntarily provide to us, such as your full name, telephone number, email address, the name of the company or organization you represent, and a general description of the matter or case about which you wish to receive advice. These data are strictly those necessary to address your inquiry and assess the viability of a potential professional relationship.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionOneBodyTwo: Likewise, and automatically, the website may collect certain technical information that is not directly identifiable, such as the Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, operating system, device used, pages visited, time spent on the site, and referral source. This information is used solely for statistical purposes and to improve the performance and browsing experience.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionTwoBody: The personal data and information you provide will be used exclusively to respond to your legal inquiries, schedule and coordinate consultations or meetings, evaluate the viability and background of your case, manage professional communications arising from a potential engagement, and, in general, fulfill the obligations inherent to the attorney-client relationship once it is formalized. Under no circumstances will we use your data for purposes other than those described herein without your express consent.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionThreeBody: The firm is committed to treating your personal data with strict confidentiality and to adopting reasonably appropriate technical, organizational, and security measures to protect them against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or improper destruction. By virtue of the professional privilege governing the practice of law, all information you share in the context of a consultation or professional relationship will be preserved under the strictest duty of confidentiality and will not be disclosed except in the cases expressly provided for in this policy or with your consent.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionFourTitle: 4. Transfer and Disclosure to Third Parties
PrivacyPolicy.sectionFourBodyOne: We guarantee that your personal data will not be sold, transferred, leased, commercialized, or shared with third parties for marketing or advertising purposes. Under no circumstances will we transfer your information in exchange for financial consideration or make it available to commercial databases.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionFourBodyTwo: Exceptionally, your data may be disclosed when strictly necessary to comply with a legal obligation, an order issued by a competent authority, or a judicial mandate, as well as to protect the rights, property, or safety of the firm, its clients, or the general public. In such cases, disclosure will be limited to the minimum information indispensable to address the corresponding request.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionFiveBodyOne: You have the right to exercise, at any time and free of charge, the rights of access, rectification, cancellation, and objection (ARCO rights) regarding the personal data concerning you that are in our possession. This includes the ability to request information about the processing of your data, correct inaccurate or incomplete data, request its deletion when it is no longer necessary for the purposes that motivated its collection, and object to its processing in legally appropriate cases.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionFiveBodyTwo: To exercise any of these rights, you may contact the firm directly through the contact channels indicated on this website (email or telephone), clearly stating the corresponding request and, where applicable, attaching the documents that allow us to verify your identity. We will respond to your request within the legally established timeframes and inform you of the outcome.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionSixBody: This website may use cookies and similar technologies in order to ensure its proper functioning, remember your browsing preferences, and, where applicable, generate anonymous statistical metrics that allow us to improve the performance and user experience. These cookies may be essential or functional, and are not used to collect identifiable personal information without your knowledge. You may configure your browser to reject or delete cookies; however, doing so may affect the operation of certain functionalities of the site.
PrivacyPolicy.sectionSevenBody: The firm reserves the right to modify, update, or supplement this Privacy Policy at any time, in order to adapt it to any relevant legislative, jurisprudential, technological, or operational changes. The modifications shall become effective upon their publication on this website; therefore, we recommend that you periodically review this page to stay informed about the processing of your personal data.
